answer.justification: Alveolar damage, such as in ARDS, destroys the thin, gas-exchanging Type I pneumocytes. Regeneration of the alveolar epithelium is mediated by Type II pneumocytes (surfactant-secreting cells), which act as progenitor cells. These cells proliferate and differentiate into Type I pneumocytes to restore the alveolar lining and lung function.
